integrity: All statements are supported by an explicit finite counting identity and an all-parameter proof; finite computation is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to full one-step subdivisions S(K_n), n>=3.
Minimum number n is already covered by arXiv:2609.33932v1; the counted polynomial and multiplicities are the contribution.
Priority against unindexed equivalent formulas is not established by a negative search.
title: Complete semitotal-domination polynomial of fully subdivided complete graphs
